evals.name: web-app-memos
evals.prompt: Make me a one-pager PDF for https://github.com/usememos/memos. I want to send it to a friend who is choosing a self-hosted notes app, so they get what it is without reading the README.
evals.expected_output: One A4 PDF about Memos, written for someone choosing a self-hosted notes app, with a device hero showing a real or labelled screen, a vector diagram of the real flow, and the real way to run it.

evals.name: library-httpx
evals.expected_output: One A4 PDF about HTTPX for technical peers, with an API-layer hero, a code sample that matches the real API, and the real install command.

evals.name: ml-whisper-letter
evals.expected_output: One US Letter PDF about Whisper for product managers, with a hero showing what goes into one transcription, numbers taken only from the repo, and plain statements of limits.
